title: Jeannie C. Riley "Harper Valley P.T.A." 8-Track Tape L-8-11 Plantation Records
descriptionText:
This listing is for a vintage Jeannie C. Riley "Harper Valley P.T.A." 8-Track Stereo Tape Cartridge (L-8-11), released on Plantation Records, duplicated by International Tape Cartridge Corporation.

The iconic title track "Harper Valley P.T.A." was a major country hit, and this cartridge features a great collection of songs from Jeannie C. Riley.

Track listing:

Program 1:
Harper Valley P.T.A.
Sippin’ Shirley Thompson
Harper Valley P.T.A.
Program 2:
Widow Jones
Mr. Harper
Run, Jeannie Run
Program 3:
The Cotton Patch
The Little Town Square
No Brass Band
Program 4:
Shed Me No Tears
The Ballad of Louise
Satan Place
Condition:

Tape: Sold untested; condition as pictured—being offered as a collectible or for display.
Labels: Moderate to heavy wear. The rear label has some peeling, staining, and discoloration. The front label has a puncture near the center.
Cartridge shell: Visible age and handling wear, including scuffs, grime, and some edge chipping.
See photos for the best description of actual condition.

Perfect for:
Collectors of vintage 8-tracks, Jeannie C. Riley fans, or those looking for authentic retro music memorabilia.
